items.narrative: As twilight's hush descends upon the desolate land, the wind whispers secrets of a bygone era. In ancient tongues, the trees themselves seem to mourn the passing of Glaurung, Father of Dragons. The last of his kind, he succumbed to mortal steel, his fiery essence extinguished like a dying ember. The darkness that once trembled at his approach now closes in, a shroud of stillness. The world weeps for the end of an age, as the silence is heavy with the weight of what could never be. Your arrow, swift and true, has brought about the downfall of one who would have ruled all. Yet, in this stillness, do you hear the distant howling of a thousand midnight skies, forever changed by your actions?

As twilight's veil lifts upon the forsaken land, you come across an ancient glade, overgrown with vines and moss, as if nature itself sought to conceal the secrets within. The air is heavy with the scent of old woodsmoke and forgotten lore. Amidst this tranquil scene, a glowing shaft of moonlight illuminates a pedestal, upon which rests a bow of unyielding beauty. Its limbs are crafted from the finest silverwood, adorned with intricate runes that shimmer like starlight on a midsummer's eve. The bow seems to hum with an ethereal music, as if the very essence of Galadriel's song has been distilled into its being. In this hallowed moment, it becomes clear: this is the Bow of Galadriel, forged by the Lady of Lothlórien herself, imbued with her unyielding resolve and unwavering commitment to justice. Will you wield its might against the gathering darkness?
